title: 17125 - 17125/P0741/001857
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses:
Automatic Transmission Fluid (ATF) Level not OK
Transmission Sealing faulty
Torque Converter faulty or incorrect Torque Converter installed
Valve for Torque Converter Clutch faulty
Torque Converter Lock-Up Clutch faulty/worn our
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin:  Automatic Transmission Fluid (ATF) Level
Kontrol edin:  Transmission Sealing
Kontrol edin:  Solenoid Valve 7 (N94)/Pressure Regulating Valve 4 (N218)
Kontrol edin:  Torque Converter Pressure Valve
Kontrol edin:  Valve for Torque Converter Clutch
Kontrol edin:  Torque Converter Lock-Up Clutch
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Passat (3B): 5-Speed Automatic Transmission (01V), Kontrol edin: Transmission Sealing (see TPL 2009761).
The NAR (North American Region) TSB 01-07-22  or  2011908 should contain similar information about the internal torque converter seal failure.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the NAR (North American Region)  Audi vehicles with the 01V/01L family transmission Kontrol edin: for similar torque converter failure issues explained in TSB 32-07-02  or  2010879/10.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
